question: Can I buy service credit for prior service, such as military service or another government job?

nuggets.text: A member in service may purchase service credit for listed prior service and leave (up to four years).
nuggets.quote: Any member in service may purchase service credit from the following categories of service or leave:

nuggets.text: Up to four years of active duty military service may be purchased.
nuggets.quote: any member in service may purchase up to four years of service credit for prior active duty military service in the armed forces of the United States

nuggets.text: The member pays the approximate normal cost of the plan, as the Board determines.
nuggets.quote: the member shall pay the approximate normal cost of the retirement plan under which the member is covered at the time of such purchase, as determined by the Board in its sole discretion.

nuggets.text: After the first 24 months the cost is the actuarial equivalent cost.
nuggets.quote: within the first 24 months of the member's active service following his first date of hire or the final day of any applicable leave of absence, as applicable, then, for each year or portion thereof to be credited at the time of purchase, the member shall pay the actuarial equivalent cost.
